programme.desc: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.

programme.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
programme.desc: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

programme.title: The Shape of Water
programme.desc: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever.

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

programme.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
programme.desc: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait.

programme.title: Joshy
programme.desc: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party.

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

programme.title: My Blind Brother
programme.desc: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams).

programme.title: Super Troopers 2
programme.desc: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear.

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

programme.title: Man Down
programme.desc: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

programme.title: The Return of Godzilla
programme.desc: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay.

programme.title: The Player
programme.desc: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders.

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

programme.title: Holla
programme.desc: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness.

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
programme.desc: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
programme.desc: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura).

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
programme.desc: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

programme.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
programme.desc: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife.

programme.title: Game Night
programme.desc: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever.

programme.title: The Apparition
programme.desc: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence.

programme.title: Enter Nowhere
programme.desc: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence.

programme.title: Odd Jobs
programme.desc: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business.

programme.title: A Hard Day's Night
programme.desc: The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. The film takes on the just-left-of-reality style of mock-documentary, following "a day in the life" of John, Paul, George, and Ringo as fame takes them by storm.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
programme.desc: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

programme.title: Ocean's 11
programme.desc: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies.

programme.title: Mississippi Masala
programme.desc: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together.

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages.

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest.

programme.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
programme.desc: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programme.desc: Sue Ellen Crandell is a teenager eagerly awaiting her mother's summer-long absence. While the babysitter looks after her rambunctious younger siblings, Sue Ellen can party and have fun. But then the babysitter abruptly dies, leaving the Crandells short on cash. Sue Ellen finds a sweet job in fashion by lying about her age and experience on her résumé. But, while her siblings run wild, she discovers the downside of adulthood.

programme.title: Hoot
programme.desc: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart.

programme.title: Gimme Shelter
programme.desc: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.

programme.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
programme.desc: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: In a prison cell somewhere in Latin America, two very different men warily confront each other. Molina (William Hurt) is first seen wrapping his head in a towel, in the shape of a turban, while Valentin (Raul Julia), bearded and classically macho in appearance, watches with a mixture of fascination and revulsion. During the time spent together, the two men come to understand and respect each other.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders.

programme.title: Sweet Dreams
programme.desc: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated.

programme.title: Hoot
programme.desc: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him.

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL.

programme.title: Chasing Mavericks
programme.desc: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his great success with "North by Northwest," director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel "Psycho." When the studio refuses to back the picture, Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. His wife, Alma Reville, has serious reservations about the film but supports him nonetheless. Still, the production strains the couple's marriage.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own.

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past.

programme.title: The Nun
programme.desc: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

programme.title: Inconceivable
programme.desc: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within.

programme.title: My Dead Dad
programme.desc: Young burnout Lucas is notified that his estranged father has passed away and has left him an apartment complex in Los Angeles. Lucas meets the eclectic tenants, and soon discovers his father was a different man than the one he knew.

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.

programme.title: Due Date
programme.desc: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges.

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies.

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.desc: Un viaje a través del mundo de la pirotecnia. La pasión de los artistas creadores de este arte.

programme.desc: Three sailors on leave back a Broadway hit.

programme.title: Without Love

programme.title: They Were Expendable
programme.desc: PT boat captains fight Japanese ships in the World War II Philippines.

programme.title: Una Pequeña Confusión
programme.desc: En esta comedia llena de eventos, dos parejas que buscan tener hijos recurren a la inseminación artificial como último recurso. La ciencia no falla y la prueba da positivo, pero los humanos si: "Una pequeña confusión" (nada pequeña) provoca que la doctora intercambie accidentalmente las muestras de esperma. Ahora… cada futura mamá lleva el bebé de un completo extraño. Este ligero cambio de planes trastoca las vidas de Lola (Ana de la Reguera) y Cuauh (Cristo Fernández), una pareja progresista de clase media con espíritu libre, y de Iñigo (Juanpa Zurita) y Majo (Vico Escorcia), un dúo joven y conservador que vive en una burbuja de privilegio. Con dos bebés en camino y mucho que explicar, ambas parejas enfrentan nueve meses de una montaña rusa emocional, confrontando sus nuevas realidades, sus vidas y visiones para la crianza, los estándares sociales y el amor, que son drásticamente diferentes. Pero, lo más importante, ¿podrán dejar de lado sus diferencias para priorizar el bienestar de sus futuros hijos?

programme.title: Los trapos sucios se lavan en casa
Nosotros Los Nobles
programme.desc: Germán Noble (Gonzalo Vega) es un hombre manipulador y un poderoso empresario. Un día Germán se da cuenta que tres sus hijos Javi (Luis Gerardo Méndez), Bárbara (Karla Souza) y Charlie (Juan Pablo Gil), están tirando sus vidas por la borda, decide darles una lección que nunca olvidaran haciéndoles creer que todas sus propiedades han sido embargadas debido a un fraude y que de ahora en adelante tendrán que hacer lo que nunca han hecho antes… trabajar

programme.title: La Vida Inmoral de la Pareja Ideal
programme.desc: Lucio (Sebastián Aguirre) y Marina (Ximena Romo) son dos jóvenes que se conocen en los primeros años de preparatoria, llegando a tener una química indescriptible, deciden comerse al mundo sin pensar que el destino les jugara una mala pasada separándolos. 25 años más tarde vuelven al mismo juego que la vida les enseñó cuando eran jóvenes y reencontrarse en circunstancias muy distintas

programme.title: Tod@s Caen
programme.desc: Adán (Omar Chaparro) y Mía (Martha Higareda) son dos estrategas que quieren enseñarles a sus respectivos amigos las reglas para ganar el juego de ligar. En un bar se conocen y a partir de ahí, usarán sus técnicas para enamorar el uno al otro en una serie de cómicos enredos y lucha de poderes, en la que quien se enamora primero… pierde

programme.title: Cásese Quien Pueda
programme.desc: Ana Paula (Martha Higareda) y Daniela (Miriam Higareda) son dos hermanas que tienen metas completamente distintas: una casarse, la otra buscar una carrera; y de cómo la vida las lleva a intercambiar sus sueños y acabar en el lugar menos esperado

programme.title: Loca por el Trabajo
programme.desc: Alicia (Bárbara de Regil) es una ejecutiva muy exitosa, adicta a su trabajo, que pone antes la necesidad de su empresa a la de su familia. En un mal día, por una absurda confusión, pierde todo lo que tiene. A pesar de toda esta situación, se hace amiga de su vecina, quien resulta ser la propietaria de una de una tienda de sex-shop. Alicia encontrará en ese lugar cosas magnificas, llenas de muy "buena vibra" y un nuevo comienzo para su vida profesional

programme.title: Asesinos Anónimos
programme.desc: Las tensiones aumentan en Killers Anonymous, un grupo de apoyo para asesinos, mientras los miembros del grupo intentan desentrañar el misterio detrás del intento de asesinato de un senador estadounidense del cual uno de ellos es responsable y que tiene en alerta máxima a las autoridades policiales de la ciudad. Pero las cosas no son como parecen, y cuando se descubren nuevas verdades, surgen alianzas secretas y traiciones a medida que las sesiones explotan en violencia y caos, ¡obligando a los asesinos a matar o ser asesinados!

programme.title: Atrapen al Gringo
programme.desc: Encarcelado por las autoridades mexicanas por haber robado dinero de un jefe de la mafia de San Diego, Driver (Mel Gibson), es enviado a una prisión de mala muerte donde conocerá los peligros de que se le conoce como “El Pueblito”. Este no es un lugar para cualquiera y mucho menos para un extranjero, a menos que reciba la ayuda de alguien como el niño de 10 años, quien a su vez necesitará la ayuda de Driver

programme.title: Baywatch: Guardianes de la Bahía
programme.desc: Matt Brody (Zac Efron) es el nuevo recluta que llega a la playa integrándose a las líneas guardianes de la bahía, en los primeros días de la llegada de Matt, Mitch Buchannon (Dwayne Johnson), descubren una serie de crimines, Mitch junto con su equipo deciden ponerse manos a la obra para detener a estos criminales, y poder defender lo que han jurado proteger

programme.title: El Roomie
programme.desc: Vivi (Fiona Palomo) es una joven escritora que se ve obligada a buscar un roomie para pagar la hipoteca de su departamento. Lo que ella no sospecha es que Ro (José Eduardo Derbez), el supuesto compañero perfecto que encontró, tiene un peculiar estilo de vida: nunca pagar renta. A pesar de que Vivi descubre a Ro, decide abrirle las puertas de su casa y de su vida porque sus artimañas la llevan a reencontrarse como escritora y tanto ella como su roomie van a descubrir su real valor

programme.title: El Precio del Mañana
programme.desc: En un futuro donde el tiempo es literalmente dinero y la vejez se detiene a los 25, la única forma de mantenerse con vida es ganar, robar o heredar más tiempo. Pero cuando un pobre de clase obrera, Will Salas (Justin Timberlake) es acusado injustamente de asesinato, el junto con la ayuda de una bella chica (Amanda Seyfried) deberán encontrar la manera de acabar con el corrupto sistema antes que sus relojes se detengan

programme.title: Matando Cabos
programme.desc: Oscar (Pedro Armendáriz Jr.) es un magnate al que todos temen, pero un día Jaque (Tony Dalton) y Mudo (Kristoff Raczynski) cometen un error de dejarlo inconsciente al magnate y deciden meterlo a un baño ahora no saben qué hacer con él

programme.title: ¿Y Cómo es Él?
programme.desc: Tomás (Mauricio Ochmann) es un hombre apacible que va a Puerto Vallarta para enfrentar al taxista que tiene un romance con su esposa, pero termina conduciendo de regreso a la Ciudad de México con él. En el transcurso de un memorable viaje de larga distancia lleno de incidentes, un extraño vínculo se desarrolla entre ambos

programme.title: El Día de la Unión
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Javier (Armando Hernández), un taxista que por azares del destino lo lleva a laborar cerca del hotel Regis el 19 de septiembre de 1985. A su alrededor observa como la ciudad de México se desmorona con el tremendo sismo de ese día. A través de esta gran historia de unión, observaremos como se forman brigadas de rescate. El día de unión es una conmemoración de las víctimas, sobrevivientes y héroes de los sismos de 1985 y 2017

programme.title: El Poderoso Victoria
programme.desc: En 1936 cuando se cierra la mina local y el futuro del pueblo se ve amenazado, Duran (Gerardo Oñate), un joven maquinista, deberá elegir entre renunciar a sus sueños y al amor de su vida o emprender la aventura de construir un tren de vapor con la ayuda de un inusual grupo de pobladores.Para ellos nada es imposible con un poco de ingenio mexicano

programme.title: La acompañante
programme.desc: Tras una escapada de fin de semana, un hombre se está dando cuenta de que está perdiendo el control de su Androide y se está volviendo loca, sangrienta y violenta

programme.title: El Precio del Mañana

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: En Karate Kid: Leyendas, tras una tragedia familiar, el prodigio del kun fu Li Fong (Ben Wang) es desarraigado de su hogar en Pekín y obligado a mudarse a Nueva York con su madre. Li lucha por superar su pasado mientras intenta integrarse con sus nuevos compañeros de clase, y aunque no quiere pelear, los problemas parecen acecharlo por todas partes. Cuando un nuevo amigo necesita su ayuda, Li participa en una competición de karate, pero sus habilidades por sí solas no son suficientes. Su profesor de kung fu, el Sr. Han (Jackie Chan), recluta al Karate Kid original, Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio), y Li aprende una nueva forma de luchar, fusionando sus dos estilos en uno para el duelo definitivo de artes marciales

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: Las leyendas chocan en Godzilla vs. Kong mientras estos míticos adversarios se encuentran en una batalla espectacular, con el destino del mundo en juego. Kong y sus protectores emprenden un peligroso viaje para encontrar su verdadero hogar, y con ellos está Jia (Kaylee Hottle), una joven huérfana con la que ha formado un vínculo único y poderoso. Pero inesperadamente se encuentran en el camino de un Godzilla enfurecido, creando destrucción en todo el mundo. El épico choque entre los dos titanes – instigado por fuerzas invisibles – es solo el comienzo del misterio que se encuentra en las profundidades del núcleo de la tierra

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Una aventura llena de acción que abarca el vasto y espectacular mundo submarino de los siete mares, Arthur Curry (Jason Momoa), mitad humano y mitad atlanticense, y lo lleva al viaje de su vida – uno que no solo lo forzará a enfrentar quien es en realidad, sino a descubrir si es digno de quién es él, nacido para ser… un rey

Su profesor de kung fu, el Sr. Han (Jackie Chan), recluta al Karate Kid original, Daniel LaRusso (Ralph Macchio), y Li aprende una nueva forma de luchar, fusionando sus dos estilos en uno para el duelo definitivo de artes marciales

programme.title: Enemigos Públicos
programme.desc: (Public Enemies) En los años de 1930 en la ciudad de Chicago, en los Estados Unidos, uno de los más notables asalta bancos, John Dillinger (Johnny Depp) ama tanto su trabajo y esto es lo que lo hace a él sentirse bien.Este delincuente ha huido de la ciudad con ningún tipo de miedo a las represalias que las autoridades tienen hacia él y su banda de delincuentes. Mientras el continua asaltando bancos y huyendo de la justicia con su banda de ladrones, el conoce a Billie Frechette (Marion Cotillard) y termina enamorándose de esta mujer que logra entrar en su corazón frio. Mientras él se enamora y empieza su romance con Billie un agente del FBI Mervin Purvis (Christian Bale) se hace cargo del caso de estos roba bancos y Purvis está obsesionado en capturar a Dillinger a toda costa y no descansará hasta capturarlo a él y su banda

programme.title: Destino Final: Lazos de Sangre
programme.desc: Atormentada por una violenta pesadilla recurrente, la estudiante universitaria Stefanie (Kaitlyn Santa Juana) regresa a casa para buscar a la única persona que podría romper el ciclo y salvar a su familia de la espantosa muerte que inevitablemente les espera a todos

programme.title: El Conjuro
programme.desc: "The Conjuring". Ed (Patrick Wilson) y Lorraine Warren (Vera Farmiga) son dos investigadores de actividad paranormal que trabajan para ayudar a una familia que se encuentra aterrorizada por una presencia oscura en la casa de su granja.Forzados a enfrentarse a este ente poderoso, los Warren se ven a sí mismos atrapados en el caso más terrorífico de sus vidas

programme.title: Evil Dead: El Despertar
programme.desc: Trasladando la acción de los bosques a la ciudad, "Evil Dead: El Despertar" cuenta la retorcida historia de dos hermanas distanciadas, cuyo reencuentro se ve truncado por la aparición de demonios poseedores de carne, lo que las empuja a una batalla primordial por la supervivencia mientras se enfrentan a la versión más pesadillesca imaginable de la familia

programme.title: Annabelle 3: Viene a Casa
programme.desc: Decididos a evitar que Annabelle cause más estragos, los demonólogos Ed (Patrick Wilson) y Lorraine Warren (Vera Farmiga) llevan a la muñeca poseída a la habitación cerrada con artefactos en su casa, colocándola "a salvo" detrás de un vidrio sagrado y alistando la bendición santa de un sacerdote. Pero una noche profana de horror aguarda a que Annabelle despierte a los espíritus malignos en la habitación, quienes se fijan en un nuevo objetivo: la hija de diez años de los Warrens, Judy (Mckenna Grace) y sus amigas

programme.title: The Gilded Age
programme.desc: La Edad Dorada estadounidense fue un período de inmensos cambios económicos, de gran conflicto entre las viejas costumbres y los nuevos sistemas, y de enormes fortunas ganadas y perdidas. En el contexto de esta transformación, "La Edad Dorada" de HBO comienza en 1882 con la joven Marian Brook (Louisa Jacobson) que se muda de la zona rural de Pensilvania a la ciudad de Nueva York después de la muerte de su padre para vivir con sus viejas tías adineradas Agnes van Rhijn (Christine Baranski) y Ada Brook (Cynthia Nixon).Acompañada por Peggy Scott (Denée Benton), una aspirante a escritora que busca un nuevo comienzo, Marian sin darse cuenta se ve envuelta en una guerra social entre una de sus tías, una descendiente del antiguo grupo de dinero, y sus vecinos tremendamente ricos, un magnate ferroviario despiadado y su ambiciosa esposa, George (Morgan Spector) y Bertha Russel (Carrie Coon). Expuesta a un mundo al borde de la era moderna, ¿seguirá Marian las reglas establecidas por la sociedad o forjará su propio camino?

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: Casi 5000 años después de que los dioses antiguos le confirieran los poderes todopoderosos y lo encarcelaran con la misma rapidez – Black Adam (Dwayne Johnson) es liberado de su tumba terrenal, listo para desatar su forma única de justicia en el mundo moderno

programme.title: Megalodón 2: El Gran Abismo
programme.desc: "Megalodón 2: El Gran Abismo", una emocionante atracción literalmente más grande que la vida que supera al éxito de taquilla de 2018 y lleva la acción a alturas más altas y profundidades aún mayores con múltiples Megalodones gigantes y mucho más. Sumérgete en aguas desconocidas con Jason Statham y el ícono de acción global Wu Jing mientras lideran un audaz equipo de investigación en una inmersión exploratoria en las profundidades más profundas del océano. Su viaje se convierte en un caos cuando una malevolente operación minera amenaza su misión y los obliga a una batalla de alto riesgo por la supervivencia. Enfrentados a colosales Megalodones e implacables saqueadores ambientales, nuestros héroes deben correr, ser más astutos y nadar más rápido que sus depredadores despiadados en una trepidante carrera contra el tiempo

programme.title: Mujer Maravilla 1984
programme.desc: Sinopsis no disponible

programme.title: Rápido y Furioso
programme.desc: Tienen la adrenalina y las máquinas malas, pero, sobre todo, tienen una necesidad extrema de velocidad. En las calles cargadas de turbo de Los Ángeles, cada noche es una carrera de campeonato. Con la furia potenciada por el nitro, Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel), gobierna el camino convirtiendo a todos sus rivales en polvo. Él y su rival, Johnny Tran (Rick Yune) son los más audaces, los más malos y los mejores. Pero ahora, hay nueva rabia en el camino. Saben que es duro, saben que es rápido, pero lo que no saben es que es un detective demoníaco de la velocidad (Paul Walker) con suficiente empuje y determinación para salir victorioso. Con una intensa acción a toda velocidad, increíbles acrobacias a alta velocidad y pedal a fondo hasta la máxima intensidad, este asalto rápido y furioso te pone en el asiento del conductor y te desafía a superar todos los límites

programme.title: The Gilded Age

programme.title: El Conjuro 4: Últimos Ritos
programme.desc: El Conjuro 4: Últimos Ritos presenta otro emocionante capítulo del ícono universo cinematográfico de El Conjuro, basado en hechos reales. Vera Farmiga y Patrick Wilson se reúnen para un último caso como los reconocidos investigadores paranormales Ed y Lorraine Warren en una impactante y escalofriante incorporación a la franquicia, que ha triunfado en taquilla a nivel mundial.Farmiga y Wilson protagonizan la película junto a Mia Tomlinson y Ben Hardy, quienes interpretan a Judy Warre, la hija de Ed y Lorraine, y su novio, Tony Spera

programme.title: Lego Batman: La Película

Pero hay grandes riesgos en la Ciudad Gótica y si él desea salvar la ciudad de él Guasón (Zach Galifianakis), Batman podría dejar de ser el vigilante solitario, tratando de trabajar con otros y quizás, tal vez, aprender a soltarse un poco

programme.title: Angry Birds 2: La película
programme.desc: Los pájaros enojados no voladores y los intrigados cerditos verdes llevan su carne al siguiente nivel cuando surge una nueva amenaza que pone en peligro tanto como a las islas de los pájaros como la isla de los cerdos. Red (Jason Sudeikis), Chuck (Josh Gad), Bomb (Danny McBride) y Mighty Eagle (Peter Dinklage) reclutan a la hermana de Chuck, Silver (Rachel Bloom) y se unen con varios cerdos: Leonard (Bill Hader), su asistente Courtney (Awkwafina), y el técnico Garry (Sterling K. Brown) – para forjar una tregua inestable y formar un súper equipo poco probable para salvar sus hogares

programme.title: No hay nada como las fiestas
Doctor Sueño
programme.desc: Dan "Danny" Torrance (Ewan McGregor), 40 años después de su aterradora estadía en el Hotel Overlook en The Shining. Todavía irrevocablemente marcado por el trauma que sufrió cuando era niño en el Overlook, Dan Torrance ha luchado para encontrar algo de paz. Pero esa paz se rompe cuando se encuentra con Abra Stone (Kyliegh Curran), una adolescente valiente con su propio poderoso regalo extrasensorial, conocido como el "brillo". Reconociendo instintivamente que Dan comparte su poder, Abra lo buscó, desperada por su ayuda contra la despiada Rosa la del Sombrero (Rebecca Ferguson) y sus seguidores, El Nudo Verdadero, que se nutre del brillo de los inocentes en su búsqueda de la inmortalidad.Formando una alianza improbable, Dan y Abra participan en una brutal batalla de vida o Muerte Con rose. La inocencia de Abra y su intrépido brillo obligan a Dan a recurrir a sus propios poderes como nunca antes – enfrentándose de inmediato a sus miedos y despertando a los fantasmas del pasado

programme.title: John Wick 3: Parabellum
programme.desc: John Wick (Keanu Reeves) regresa con un precio de $14 millones en su cabeza y un ejército de asesinos caza recompensas tras el botín. Después de matar a un miembro del misterioso gremio internacional de asesinos de la Mesa Alta, John Wick queda excomulgado, pero los hombres y mujeres más despiadados del mundo esperan su turno pacientemente

programme.title: John Wick 4
programme.desc: John Wick (Keanu Reeves) descubre un camino para derrotar a La Mesa. Pero antes de poder ganar su libertad, Wick deberá enfrentarse a un nuevo enemigo con poderosas alianzas en todo el mundo; y contar las fuerzas que convierten a viejos amigos en enemigos

programme.title: ¡Hombre al Agua!
programme.desc: Leonardo (Eugenio Derbez), un playboy egoísta, mimado y de la familia más adinerada de México y Kate (Anna Faris), una madre soltera de clase trabajadora es contratada para limpiar el yate de lujo de Leonardo. Después de haber sido despedida injustamente y negarse a pagarle a ella, Leonardo hace una fiesta donde bebe demasiado y cae por la borda quedando inconsciente y despertando en la costa de Oregón con amnesia. Cuando Kate se entera de esto, ella se presenta en el hospital y decidida a recuperar su dinero, convence a Leonardo que él es su marido y hace que trabaje por primera vez en su vida. Al principio miserable e inepto, Leonardo se instala lentamente. Finalmente se gana el respeto de su nueva "familia" y sus compañeros de trabajo. Pero, con la familia de Leonardo multimillonaria en camino, y la posibilidad que su memoria pudiera regresar en cualquier momento, ¿Durará con su nueva familia o Leonardo finalmente recordara todo y la dejará para siempre?

programme.title: Ni en tu casa ni en la mia

programme.desc: Un Pequeño Favor, se centra en Stephanie (Anna Kendrick), una mami video bloguera que busca descubrir la verdad detrás de la desaparición repentina de su mejor amiga Emily (Blake Lively) de su pequeño pueblo

programme.title: Posdata: Te Amo

programme.title: Evil • El demonio del dinero
programme.desc: El demonio del dinero | El equipo investiga denuncias sobre un demonio que persigue a personas que invirtieron en la bolsa de valores. La entidad le pide ayuda a David para hacer regresar a Grace Ling.

programme.title: FBI • De mal en peor
programme.desc: De mal en peor | Un atraco mortal a un camión arma a los asesinos con suficiente nitrato de amonio para construir una bomba superdestructiva. El equipo descubre un vínculo con un grupo terrorista en el que Maggie está trabajando para infiltrarse.

programme.title: FBI • Hijo afortunado

programme.title: Apolo bajo fuego
programme.desc: Zara es acusada de asesinato al descubrir el alcance del complot de Voltov. Perseguida y sin a quién recurrir, debe huir para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: House M.D • La euforia
programme.desc: La euforia | House y el equipo tratan el extraño caso de un policía que ingresa al hospital con heridas de bala en la cabeza y risas incontrolables. Foreman presenta los mismos síntomas y el equipo debe darse prisa para encontrar el diagnóstico correcto.

programme.title: House M.D • Sin razón
programme.desc: Sin razón | Mientras el equipo trabaja en el diagnóstico de un hombre con una gran inflamación de lengua, un desconocido entra a la oficina de House y le dispara. Sin embargo, House continúa con el tratamiento del paciente desde su propia cama en el hospital.

programme.title: House M.D • Sentido

programme.title: FBI • Héroes

programme.desc: Repetición ║ Es un espacio de turismo que muestra diferentes destinos, testimonios de viajeros e historias de cada lugar con la compañía y conducción de Mariana Bonelli. El formato contempla una crónica vívida y pormenorizada de cada destino con el testimonio en primera persona de su conductora o enviados especiales, lo cual le brinda un estilo único y atractivo ya que permite que el espectador se sienta formando parte del recorrido. Por otro lado, la experiencia de viaje en el proceso de producción permite brindar información y datos útiles que pueden ayudar a la audiencia a tomar una buena decisión al momento de programar un viaje. Excursiones, paisajes, usos y costumbres de cada lugar, naturaleza, urbanismo, historias, leyendas, mitos, platos típicos, música, actividades y servicios turísticos de excelencia mostrados con distinción y dinamismo.

programme.desc: Repetición ║ Segmento dedicado especialmente a quienes gustan de los viajes y el turismo y desean estar al tanto de todas las novedades de esta actividad tan apasionante. Con un formato actual, le ofrece las mejores propuestas para conocer los destinos más fascinantes, toda la información destacada del sector y entrevistas con referentes de la industria turística, el mundo del espectáculo, la cultura y los negocios, en los más bellos paisajes. En cada edición, podrás disfrutar de las mejores imágenes de destinos nacionales, regionales e internacionales; distinguidas sugerencias de hotelería, cruceros de todo el mundo y emprendimientos turísticos relacionados con el alojamiento, la gastronomía y los entretenimientos. Además, interesantes notas realizadas en escenarios privilegiados por la naturaleza, con personalidades de los más variados ámbitos relacionados con el turismo, la cultura y el arte. Espacios dedicados a la actualidad de la industria turística, las tendencias, curiosidades, notas de color y selección de las mejores ofertas que propone el mercado cada semana. Además, encontrarás el asesoramiento profesional de todo el abanico de servicios que conforman la preparación de un viaje inolvidable, con recomendaciones de hotelería, transportación aérea, asistencia al viajero, alquiler de autos, paseos, excursiones y gastronomía.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 8
programme.desc: Trixie y la hermana Mary Cynthia se unen para apoyar a una futura madre sorda, mientras un caso de malestar matutino resulta ser más serio de lo esperado inicialmente. Por otro lado, la hija de Fred está poco entusiasmada con su próxima boda.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Especial: Navidad 2015: Episodio 1
programme.desc: La alegría festiva está en todas partes con Poplar preparándose para Navidad. Una sorpresa inesperada para una madre doliente ayuda a que le llegue la magia de la Navidad, mientras que Nonnatus se sacude cuando uno de los suyos desaparece.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Especial: Navidad 2015: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Una sorpresa inesperada para una madre doliente ayuda a que le llegue la magia de la Navidad, mientras que Nonnatus se sacude cuando uno de los suyos desaparece.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Se acerca la Pascua, y las hermanas y las comadronas se ven alteradas por el nacimiento de un bebé con deformidades graves e inexplicables.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Barbara es puesta a prueba cuando la preocupada esposa de un estibador se ve forzada a tomar una difícil decisión sobre su parto inminente.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 3
programme.desc: El brote de una enfermedad trae recuerdos malos para Patsy, mientras que la hermana Winifred se ve forzada a reconiderar su prejuicios cuando lidia con una futura madre. Bárbara se enfrenta a un dilema cuando Tom la invita a cenar.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Las presiones de la Gran Bretaña moderna alcanzan a Poplar como un segundo hospital y un nacimiento difícil plantea preguntas morales para la hermana Julienne. Trixie y Tom ayudan a una famila separada bajo la presión de los sueños de su hijo a futuro.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 5
programme.desc: El pasado de la nueva madre Roseanne continúa persiguiéndola, causando grandes estragos y una lesión en la espalda fuerza a Violet a poner su amado negocio al cuidado de Fred.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 6
programme.desc: Una avalancha de ataques violentos en una mujer impacta directamente en los residentes de la casa Nonnatus. Un embarazo secreto amenaza la vida de la joven.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 7
programme.desc: El Dr. Turner se prepara para la introducción de la píldora anticonceptiva, mientras Patsy se esfuerza para ayudar a una mujer Bargee, decidida a dar a luz entre los de su propia comunidad.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 8
programme.desc: Poplar se ve alterada ya que se descubre la causa de recientes deformidades infantiles, mientras que la casa Nonnatus cae en un caos por una tragedia aún más cerca de casa. Mientras tanto, las comadronas ayudan a una madre que se pone de parto en su boda.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Jenny Lee, una comadrona recién titulada, llega al East End para trabajar con una congregación de monjas.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Mientras Jenny Lee se adapta a su puesto, llega un nuevo miembro a Nonnatus House, Chummy.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Jenny se incorpora a la lista de enfermeras para adquirir experiencia en la práctica comunitaria.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a un bebé de su cochecito, la comunidad local se une para buscarlo.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Jenny cuida de Frank, un enfermo de cáncer, y descubre que el amor puede manifestarse de muchas formas.

programme.title: Llama a la comadrona: Episodio 6
programme.desc: Jenny se da cuenta de que la profesión de comadrona está llena de inesperados acontecimientos cuando juzgan a la hermana Monica Joan.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Cuando el director de la nueva sinfonía de Toronto es asesinado, Murdoch sospecha que músicos celosos son los responsables.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Cuando una novia colapsa y muere misteriosamente antes de su boda, Murdoch sospecha que fue envenenada por su perfume.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: La investigación de Murdoch sobre el asesinato de un agente es obstaculizada por la interferencia del reemplazo entusiasta de Brackenreid.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Disgustado por las tácticas del nuevo inspector, Murdoch renuncia y es contratado en privado para encontrar a una heredera desaparecida.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: La primera tarea de Crabtree como inspector es encontrar a Murdoch y Ogden, quienes han sido secuestrados.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Con su bebé a salvo, Murdoch y Ogden planean vengarse del asesino que exoneraron.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch investiga a Emily Carr por el asesinato de un hombre sospechoso de robar la Mona Lisa.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch investiga un asesinato en un animado bar de ostras que también funciona como burdel.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Tras pedir un deseo a una adivina mecánica, el grupo desciende a una casa de los horrores.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Cuando un huésped en un retiro de salud muere, Ogden, Watts y Effie sospechan del carismático líder.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Días antes de una carrera, Murdoch investiga la sospechosa muerte de un caballo favorito para ganar.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Ogden, Hart, Effie y Louise conocen a unas aventureras en el bosque que huyen de un asesino loco.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch investiga la muerte de un hombre encontrado en la bolsa de juguetes de Santa en un desfile navideño.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch sospecha de un asesino profesional en el tiroteo de un empresario en una barbería.
programme.sub-title: El barrio de la señora Crabtree

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch sospecha de antiguas rivalidades de bandas en el apuñalamiento de un bailarín en los Juegos de las Tierras Altas.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch sospecha que una muerte está vinculada a un evento de adivinación en el salón Starbright de Hart.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Crabtree se dirige al norte para interceptar a su padre fugitivo y en su lugar encuentra a un policía asesinado.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Cuando Crabtree viaja al norte para interceptar a su padre fugitivo, encuentra a un policía muerto y una comunidad de bribones.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch y Watts van en busca de un tesoro para encontrar oro inca robado y a un asesino.
programme.sub-title: Murdoch y El Tesoro de Lima

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch investiga la muerte de un hombre en una reunión dirigida por un carismático predicador.

programme.title: Los Misterios de Murdoch
programme.desc: Murdoch investiga al futuro primer ministro Robert Borden por el asesinato de un asociado.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: El misterio de la guía de ferrocarriles
programme.desc: Poirot recibe cartas de un asesino en serie que se mofa de él y que parece elegir alfabéticamente a sus víctimas y las escenas de los crímenes.
programme.sub-title: El misterio de la guía de ferrocarriles

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: Muerte en las nubes
programme.desc: Mientras Poirot duerme durante un vuelo de París a Londres, un notorio prestamista francés es asesinado mediante un dardo envenenado.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: El misterioso caso del zapato
programme.desc: Poco después de que Poirot realice una visita rutinaria al dentista, el doctor se suicida. Por ello, el inspector jefe Japp recluta al célebre detective de dos maneras: como consultor y como testigo.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Miss Marple ES: Hacia cero
programme.desc: La señorita Marple ha visitado a Camilla, una amiga de la infancia que está acompañada de invitados. Cuando ella y uno de sus amigos aparecen muertos, Marple debe iniciar una investigación.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: La aventura de la tumba egipcia
programme.desc: Poco después de abrir una antigua tumba egipcia, los miembros de la expedición empiezan a fallecer uno a uno. Poirot viaja a Egipto para desentrañar el misterio de la aparente maldición del faraón.
programme.sub-title: La aventura de la tumba egipcia

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: El inferior
programme.desc: Poirot investiga el asesinato del cruel director ejecutivo de una compañía química, cuyo cadáver aparece en su casa después de que la fórmula de un nuevo producto revolucionario haya sido robada.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: Iris amarillos
programme.desc: Un hombre celebra el segundo aniversario de la muerte de su esposa, envenenada mediante cianuro cuando estaba en Argentina. Un fallecimiento que el mismo Poirot presenció y no pudo resolver.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Miss Marple ES: Némesis
programme.desc: Miss Marple y su sobrino, el novelista Raymond West, hacen un tour de casas históricas con un grupo ecléctico. Ambos deben resolver el caso de asesinato del financiero John Rafiel.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: El caso del testamento desaparecido
programme.desc: Un enfermo terminal pide a Poirot que sea el ejecutor de su nuevo testamento, pero es asesinado antes de poder redactarlo. Además, la antigua voluntad del fallecido también ha sido robada.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Poirot ES: La aventura del noble italiano
